```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)        # data wrangling
library(tidyr)        # pivot_longer()
library(readxl)       # read_excel()
library(lme4)         # lmer()
library(lmerTest)     # Satterthwaite df and p values for lmer models
library(emmeans)      # estimated marginal means and contrasts
library(parameters)   # model_parameters()
library(performance)  # icc(), r2_nakagawa(), check_model()
library(psych)        # describe(), alpha(), corr.test()
library(ggplot2)      # figures
library(patchwork)    # combining figures
```

# DATA PREPARATION

## Read in data
```{r}
PORS <- read_excel("PORS_task.xlsx", sheet = "Clean")
Demo <- read_excel("PORS_survey.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1") %>% rename(Subject = ID)

# Interaction frequency (hours per week together, reported by experiencers at pre-screening)
# Experiencer IDs start at 1001; helper IDs are in the 100s
Freq <- read_excel("PORS_hours.xlsx", sheet = "Hours") %>%
  filter(ID >= 1000) %>%
  transmute(Subject = as.character(ID), Hours = as.numeric(Hours))
```

## Participant exclusions
```{r}
# Number of participants before exclusion
n_distinct(PORS$Subject)

# No variance in responses: same score in 10 or more consecutive ratings
items <- c("PE1", "PE2", "Diff1", "Diff2", "Plau", "Success")

Response_variance <- PORS %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(items), names_to = "item", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  mutate(item = factor(item, levels = items)) %>%  # keep item order within each trial
  arrange(Subject, row_id, item) %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  summarise(max_run_same_value = max(rle(value)$lengths), .groups = "drop")

Response_variance %>% filter(max_run_same_value >= 10) %>% pull(Subject)
# 1009, 1034, 1042, 1100, 1127

# No variance in PE: same score on more than 90% of reappraisal trials in either phase
PE_noVariance <- PORS %>%
  filter(!Trial %in% c("Look Negative", "Look Neutral")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PE1, PE2), names_to = "Phase", values_to = "PE") %>%
  count(Subject, Phase, PE, name = "n_PE") %>%
  group_by(Subject, Phase) %>%
  summarise(prop_mode = max(n_PE) / sum(n_PE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(prop_mode >= 0.90)
PE_noVariance
# 1048

exclude_ids <- c(1009, 1034, 1042, 1100, 1127, 1048)
PORS <- PORS %>% filter(!Subject %in% exclude_ids)
Demo <- Demo %>% filter(!Subject %in% exclude_ids)

n_distinct(PORS$Subject) # 78
```

## Person-level variables
```{r}
# The first 21 dyads chose their roles; later dyads were randomly assigned
self_ids <- as.character(setdiff(1001:1034,
                                 c(1004, 1008, 1013, 1014, 1018, 1020, 1023,
                                   1024, 1028, 1029, 1030, 1032, 1033)))

relationship_items <- c("Support", "Significance", "Close", "Trust", "Know")

Demo <- Demo %>%
  mutate(Subject = as.character(Subject)) %>%
  left_join(Freq, by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    relationship = rowMeans(across(all_of(relationship_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    Assign = factor(ifelse(Subject %in% self_ids, "Self-selected", "Random"),
                    levels = c("Random", "Self-selected"))
  ) %>%
  # Grand-mean centering for moderation models
  mutate(across(c(relationship, Length), ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_mc"))

# Every experiencer should have an hours value (should be 0)
sum(is.na(Demo$Hours))

PORS <- PORS %>%
  mutate(Subject = as.character(Subject), Image = factor(Image)) %>%
  left_join(Demo, by = "Subject")
```

## Dataframes without a Phase variable
```{r}
# Neg_collapsed         = negative-image trials (Look Negative, Solo, Social)
# Reapp_collapsed       = reappraisal trials (Solo, Social)
# Reapp_collapsed_clean = reappraisal trials, excluding trials with any 0 ("did not do it") response
Neg_collapsed <- PORS %>%
  filter(Trial != "Look Neutral") %>%
  mutate(Trial = factor(Trial, levels = c("Look Negative", "Solo", "Social")))

Reapp_collapsed <- Neg_collapsed %>%
  filter(Trial != "Look Negative") %>%
  mutate(Trial = factor(Trial, levels = c("Solo", "Social")))

Reapp_collapsed_clean <- Reapp_collapsed %>%
  filter(
    is.na(Diff1)   | Diff1   != 0,
    is.na(Diff2)   | Diff2   != 0,
    is.na(Plau)    | Plau    != 0,
    is.na(Success) | Success != 0
  )

# Person-mean (pm), within-person (wp), and between-person (bp) versions for exploratory models
Reapp_collapsed_clean <- Reapp_collapsed_clean %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(across(c(Diff1, Diff2, Plau, PE1, PE2), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_pm")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Diff1_wp = Diff1 - Diff1_pm,
    Diff2_wp = Diff2 - Diff2_pm,
    Plau_wp  = Plau  - Plau_pm,
    PE1_wp   = PE1   - PE1_pm,
    PE2_wp   = PE2   - PE2_pm,
    Diff1_bp = Diff1_pm - mean(Diff1_pm, na.rm = TRUE),
    Diff2_bp = Diff2_pm - mean(Diff2_pm, na.rm = TRUE),
    Plau_bp  = Plau_pm  - mean(Plau_pm,  na.rm = TRUE),
    PE1_bp   = PE1_pm   - mean(PE1_pm,   na.rm = TRUE),
    PE2_bp   = PE2_pm   - mean(PE2_pm,   na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Number of implementation tactics used on each trial
tactics <- paste0("Tactic", 1:5)
Reapp_collapsed_clean <- Reapp_collapsed_clean %>%
  mutate(n_tactics = rowSums(across(all_of(tactics)) == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## Dataframes with a Phase variable
```{r}
# Reapp_phase       = reappraisal trials in long format (one row per phase)
# Reapp_phase_clean = same, excluding trials with any 0 ("did not do it") response
PORS_phase <- PORS %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(PE1, PE2, Diff1, Diff2),
               names_to = c(".value", "Phase"),
               names_pattern = "(PE|Diff)([12])") %>%
  mutate(Phase = factor(Phase, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("Generate/Listen", "Implement")))

Reapp_phase <- PORS_phase %>%
  filter(Trial %in% c("Solo", "Social")) %>%
  mutate(Trial = factor(Trial, levels = c("Solo", "Social")))

# Rows are excluded if that phase's difficulty, or plausibility or success, is 0
Reapp_phase_clean <- Reapp_phase %>%
  filter(
    is.na(Diff)    | Diff    != 0,
    is.na(Plau)    | Plau    != 0,
    is.na(Success) | Success != 0
  )
```

## Dataframes for gender analyses
```{r}
# Dyads in which both members identified as a man or a woman
gender_labels <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    filter(Gender %in% c(1, 2), h_Gender %in% c(1, 2)) %>%
    mutate(Gender   = factor(Gender,   levels = c(2, 1), labels = c("Man", "Woman")),
           h_Gender = factor(h_Gender, levels = c(2, 1), labels = c("Man", "Woman")))
}
Reapp_phase_clean_g     <- gender_labels(Reapp_phase_clean)
Reapp_collapsed_clean_g <- gender_labels(Reapp_collapsed_clean)
```

## Dataframe for mediation
```{r}
# Complete cases on reappraisal origin, Phase 1 difficulty, plausibility, and Phase 1 PE,
# with mediators re-centered within this subset
med_dat <- Reapp_collapsed_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(PE1), !is.na(Diff1), !is.na(Plau), !is.na(Trial)) %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(Diff1_pm = mean(Diff1), Plau_pm = mean(Plau),
         Diff1_wp = Diff1 - Diff1_pm, Plau_wp = Plau - Plau_pm) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Diff1_bp = Diff1_pm - mean(Diff1_pm),
         Plau_bp  = Plau_pm  - mean(Plau_pm))
```

## Trial exclusions
```{r}
# Trials with at least one 0 ("did not do it") response, by trial type
Reapp_collapsed %>%
  mutate(excluded = Diff1 == 0 | Diff2 == 0 | Plau == 0 | Success == 0) %>%
  group_by(Trial) %>%
  summarise(n_original  = n(),
            n_excluded  = sum(excluded, na.rm = TRUE),
            pct_excluded = 100 * n_excluded / n_original,
            .groups = "drop")

# Trials with no generation/receipt but implementation reported
no_gen <- Reapp_collapsed %>%
  mutate(no_gen_imp = (Diff1 == 0 | Plau == 0) & Success > 0)

no_gen %>%
  group_by(Trial) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(no_gen_imp, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
sum(no_gen$no_gen_imp, na.rm = TRUE)
100 * mean(no_gen$no_gen_imp, na.rm = TRUE)

# Participants with at least one such trial
no_gen %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  summarise(any = any(no_gen_imp, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(any), pct = 100 * mean(any))
```

## Role assignment (footnote)
```{r}
# Does role assignment (self-selected vs. random) moderate the main effects?
# Likelihood-ratio test of all assignment terms against each main model
specs <- list(
  PE2          = list(fixed = "PE2 ~ Trial",          re = "(1 + Trial | Subject)",         data = Neg_collapsed),
  PE           = list(fixed = "PE ~ Phase * Trial",   re = "(1 + Phase + Trial | Subject)", data = Reapp_phase_clean),
  Success      = list(fixed = "Success ~ Trial",      re = "(1 + Trial | Subject)",         data = Reapp_collapsed_clean),
  Difficulty   = list(fixed = "Diff ~ Phase * Trial", re = "(1 + Phase + Trial | Subject)", data = Reapp_phase_clean),
  Plausibility = list(fixed = "Plau ~ Trial",         re = "(1 + Trial | Subject)",         data = Reapp_collapsed_clean)
)

fit_spec <- function(fixed, re, data) {
  lmer(as.formula(paste(fixed, "+", re)), data = data, REML = FALSE, na.action = na.exclude)
}

assign_tests <- bind_rows(lapply(names(specs), function(nm) {
  s    <- specs[[nm]]
  base <- fit_spec(s$fixed, s$re, s$data)
  mod  <- fit_spec(sub("~\\s*(.*)$", "~ (\\1) * Assign", s$fixed), s$re, s$data)
  lrt  <- anova(base, mod)
  tibble(Outcome = nm, Chisq = lrt$Chisq[2], df = lrt$Df[2],
         p = lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], singular = isSingular(mod))
}))
knitr::kable(assign_tests, digits = c(0, 2, 0, 3, 0))

# Group sizes
Demo %>% count(Assign)
```

## Figure 2: Positive emotion, difficulty, and plausibility
```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 4.5}
bar_phase <- function(emm, ylab) {
  ggplot(as.data.frame(emm), aes(x = Trial, y = emmean, fill = Phase)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE),

    labs(x = "Trial Type", y = ylab, fill = "Phase") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:7) +

}
```

## Mediation: difficulty and plausibility (Figure 3; Supplement Table S7)
```{r}
# X = reappraisal origin (Solo = 0, Social = 1)
# M = Phase 1 difficulty and plausibility (parallel, within-person)
# Y = Phase 1 positive emotion
# Person-mean difficulty and plausibility are covariates in the b-path model

# Fit the path models for a given random-effects structure
fit_paths <- function(re, data = med_dat) {
  f <- function(model) as.formula(paste(model, "+", re))
  list(
    c  = lmer(f("PE1 ~ Trial"),   data = data, REML = FALSE),   # total effect
    a1 = lmer(f("Diff1 ~ Trial"), data = data, REML = FALSE),   # origin -> difficulty
    a2 = lmer(f("Plau ~ Trial"),  data = data, REML = FALSE),   # origin -> plausibility
    b  = lmer(f("PE1 ~ Trial + Diff1_wp + Plau_wp + Diff1_bp + Plau_bp"),
              data = data, REML = FALSE)                        # b paths and direct effect (c')
  )
}

# Monte Carlo confidence intervals for the indirect effects (Preacher & Selig, 2012)
mc_mediation <- function(m, n = 20000, seed = 2026) {
  set.seed(seed)
  x  <- "TrialSocial"
  bv <- c("Diff1_wp", "Plau_wp")
  a1 <- rnorm(n, fixef(m$a1)[x], sqrt(vcov(m$a1)[x, x]))
  a2 <- rnorm(n, fixef(m$a2)[x], sqrt(vcov(m$a2)[x, x]))
  b  <- MASS::mvrnorm(n, fixef(m$b)[bv], as.matrix(vcov(m$b)[bv, bv]))

  ind <- cbind(difficulty = a1 * b[, 1], plausibility = a2 * b[, 2])
  ind <- cbind(ind, total = ind[, 1] + ind[, 2])

  est <- c(fixef(m$a1)[x] * fixef(m$b)[bv[1]], fixef(m$a2)[x] * fixef(m$b)[bv[2]])
  est <- c(est, sum(est))

  list(
    indirect = round(cbind(estimate = unname(est),
                           t(apply(ind, 2, quantile, c(.025, .975)))), 3),
    prop_mediated = round(unname(est[3] / fixef(m$c)[x]), 3)  # total indirect / total effect
  )
}

med_main <- fit_paths("(1 + Trial | Subject)")
sapply(med_main, isSingular)

# Paths: a1, a2 = TrialSocial; b1, b2 = Diff1_wp, Plau_wp; c = TrialSocial in c;
# c' = TrialSocial in b
lapply(med_main, function(m) model_parameters(m, ci_method = "satterthwaite", effects = "fixed"))

mc_mediation(med_main)
```

## Assumption checks
```{r}
models <- list(m1 = m1, m3 = m3, m2 = m2, m5 = m5, m6 = m6, m4 = m4)

# Singular fits and convergence warnings (want all FALSE / NULL)
sapply(models, isSingular)
sapply(models, function(m) m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages)

# Residual normality, homoscedasticity, and random-effect normality
for (m in models) print(check_model(m, check = c("qq", "homogeneity", "reqq")))
```

## Table S4: Descriptive statistics and correlations
```{r}
vars_trial  <- c("PE1", "PE2", "Diff1", "Diff2", "Plau", "Success")
vars_person <- c("Length", "Hours")   # one value per person, so between-person only
vars        <- c(vars_trial, vars_person)

# Means and SDs: trial level for task variables, person level for Length and Hours
describe(Reapp_collapsed_clean[vars_trial])
describe(Demo[vars_person])

# Between-person: correlations among person means
r_between <- Reapp_collapsed_clean %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(vars), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

# Within-person: correlations among person-mean-centered trial scores
r_within <- Reapp_collapsed_clean %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_trial), ~ .x - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  ungroup()

bt <- corr.test(r_between[vars],      use = "pairwise", adjust = "none")
wt <- corr.test(r_within[vars_trial], use = "pairwise", adjust = "none")

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
get_w <- function(m, a, b) if (a %in% vars_trial && b %in% vars_trial) m[a, b] else NA

corr_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(combn(vars, 2, simplify = FALSE), function(x) {
  wr <- get_w(wt$r, x[1], x[2]); wp <- get_w(wt$p, x[1], x[2])
  data.frame(
    Variable_1 = x[1],
    Variable_2 = x[2],
    Between_r  = round(bt$r[x[1], x[2]], 2),
    Between_p  = fmt_p(bt$p[x[1], x[2]]),
    Within_r   = round(wr, 2),
    Within_p   = if (is.na(wp)) NA else fmt_p(wp)
  )
}))
corr_table
```

## Table S6: Implementation tactics
```{r}
# 1 = focus on details, 2 = add details, 3 = imagine playing out, 4 = imagine future, 5 = other

# Proportion of trials using each tactic
Reapp_collapsed_clean %>%
  group_by(Trial) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(tactics), ~ mean(. == 1, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(tactics), names_to = "Tactic", values_to = "Proportion")

# One vs. multiple tactics
Reapp_collapsed_clean %>%
  group_by(Trial) %>%
  summarise(n_total   = sum(!is.na(n_tactics)),
            n_1       = sum(n_tactics == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_2plus   = sum(n_tactics >= 2, na.rm = TRUE),
            pct_1     = n_1 / n_total,
            pct_2plus = n_2plus / n_total,
            .groups = "drop")

# Most common combinations among multi-tactic trials
Reapp_collapsed_clean %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(combo = paste(tactics[which(c_across(all_of(tactics)) == 1)], collapse = " + ")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n_tactics >= 2) %>%
  count(Trial, combo, sort = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(Trial) %>%
  mutate(pct_multi = n / sum(n),                                              # % of multi-tactic trials
         pct_all   = n / sum(Reapp_collapsed_clean$Trial == unique(Trial))) %>% # % of all trials
  ungroup()
```

# ROBUSTNESS CHECK: IMAGES AS A RANDOM FACTOR

Models from the manuscript and supplement re-estimated with participants and images as crossed random factors (Judd et al., 2012).

- By image: random intercepts and random slopes for Trial in every model.
- By-image Phase slopes were dropped (near zero, singular or nonconvergent) except in the difficulty model.
- Plausibility -> PE models: by-image random slopes for Plau_wp instead of Trial, mirroring the by-participant structure.
- By-participant random effects are the same as above, except the gender model of plausibility, which adds by-participant Trial slopes to match the main plausibility model.

```{r}
# Satterthwaite df for emmeans/emtrends in the robustness models. This changes a global
# emmeans setting, so the main-analysis chunks above should be run before this one.
emm_options(lmer.df = "satterthwaite", lmerTest.limit = 6000)
```

## Singular fits and convergence warnings for the robustness models
```{r}
img_models <- Filter(function(x) inherits(x, "merMod"),
                     mget(grep("_img$", ls(), value = TRUE)))
img_models <- c(img_models, setNames(med_img, paste0("med_img$", names(med_img))))

data.frame(
  model    = names(img_models),
  singular = sapply(img_models, isSingular),
  converge_warning = sapply(img_models, function(m) {
    msg <- m@optinfo$conv$lme4$messages
    if (is.null(msg)) "" else paste(msg, collapse = "; ")
  }),
  row.names = NULL
)
```
